title: Power Sequencer FSM
constraints: Moore FSM (outputs from the state only). **Power down** from ON on `sleep_req`: STOP_CLK (clock off) → ISOLATE (iso on) → SAVE (`save` pulse) → PWR_OFF (`pwr_en = 0`, wait for `pwr_ack = 0`) → OFF.
**Power up** from OFF on `wake_req`: PWR_ON (`pwr_en = 1`, wait for `pwr_ack = 1`) → RESTORE (`restore` pulse) → DEISO (iso off) → ON (clock on).

Outputs per state (clk_en, iso_en, save, restore, pwr_en, asleep): ON 1,0,0,0,1,0 · STOP_CLK 0,0,0,0,1,0 · ISOLATE 0,1,0,0,1,0 · SAVE 0,1,1,0,1,0 · PWR_OFF 0,1,0,0,0,0 · OFF 0,1,0,0,0,1 · PWR_ON 0,1,0,0,1,0 · RESTORE 0,1,0,1,1,0 · DEISO 0,0,0,0,1,0.
States without a wait condition last exactly one cycle. Requests in other states are ignored. Synchronous reset → ON.
hints: Nine states. The only conditional transitions are ON (sleep_req), PWR_OFF / PWR_ON (pwr_ack) and OFF (wake_req).
The order is what matters: stop the clock before isolating, isolate before saving, and power off last. Power-up is the mirror image.
`pwr_ack` comes from the power switch network: it takes several cycles for the rail to ramp.

examples.title: sleep
examples.expected: STOP_CLK, ISOLATE, SAVE, PWR_OFF, then OFF after pwr_ack falls

examples.title: wake
examples.expected: PWR_ON until pwr_ack, RESTORE, DEISO, ON
